resources.string: Enter a version code greater than zero that fits in a 64-bit number.

Version %1$d is installed, but you selected %2$d. Android usually blocks downgrading installed apps, and older releases might not read newer app data. Back up important data first. Aurora will not uninstall the app or erase its data automatically. Continue only if you understand the risks.
Version history comes from Exodus reports, not an APK archive. A listed version may no longer be available from Play.
